sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Live translate — Gemini API model documentation
sources.evidence: Names the exact preview endpoint; specifies audio input, translated audio and transcript output, 131072 input tokens, 65536 output tokens, and no thinking or function calling.

sources.title: Live translation with Gemini Live API
sources.evidence: The exact model translates speech across 70+ languages. The guide restricts input to audio and use to translation without tools or instructions. Its v1beta BidiGenerateContent WebSocket example requests AUDIO and optional input/output transcription.

sources.title: Fluid, natural voice translation with Gemini 3.5 Live Translate
sources.evidence: June 9, 2026 announcement explicitly releases Gemini 3.5 Live Translate that day in public developer preview through Gemini Live API and Google AI Studio; describes speech-to-speech translation across more than 70 languages.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Audio (Live Translate, Transcribe, Transcribe Live) model card
sources.evidence: August 26 card explicitly identifies Live Translate as based on Gemini 3 Pro and refers its architecture to that card. Lists API/product distribution and service terms. Gives no parameter counts. Its broader audio-and-text input statement differs from the endpoint's audio-only restriction. The linked PDF was also checked.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro model card
sources.evidence: The Architecture section describes a sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer with token routing to a subset of experts. Used through Live Translate's explicit architecture cross-reference, not by an assumed family resemblance. No numeric total or active count is disclosed. Architecture was verified in the downloaded PDF.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: The API operates under Google service terms, including restrictions on extracting underlying models or parameter weights. Together with the exact model card's hosted distribution, supports a proprietary, closed-weight classification.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Audio model card
sources.evidence: Inspected the later September audio card for retrospective size disclosures or comparison rows. It contains no parameter counts or Live Translate comparison establishing this model's total or active count. Its own capabilities were not transferred.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon model card
sources.evidence: Inspected the October 13 card and its comparison material for later exact-model disclosure; no Live Translate total or active parameter count is supplied.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Live Translate — Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
sources.evidence: Documents the same identifier through BidiGenerateContent with audio input/output and optional transcripts, no thinking or function calling. Lists an August 2026 Cloud preview release, later than the explicit June 9 developer API launch.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Audio (Live Translate): Model evaluation
sources.evidence: Exact-model evaluation document covers translation quality, latency and speech naturalness using Gemini Live API outputs. It provides no architecture or parameter-size comparison table.

sources.title: Models.dev exact model record
sources.evidence: Fetched raw TOML underlying the baseline link. It identifies a realtime audio model and links the official API page, guide, card and launch announcement. Used only for provenance and normalization, not as verification of technical claims.

name.note: Official product name plus the endpoint's explicitly documented Preview stage.

developer.note: Google announces and Google DeepMind documents the model.

family.note: Retain the catalog's normalized family key: the exact Live Translate card explicitly establishes Gemini 3 Pro lineage.

release_date.note: The June 9 announcement states the public developer preview starts that day. Cloud's August preview is a later distribution launch, not the earliest public release.

open_weights.note: Google documents hosted API/product distribution governed by service terms; no downloadable model weights are offered.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the model's service terms, not the CC BY documentation or Apache code-example licenses.

parameters_b.note: No total is disclosed in the exact card, its referenced base card, exact-model evaluation document or later cards inspected. Exact-name primary training/interpretability and parameter searches found no additional disclosure. No base/sibling count is assumed.

active_parameters_b.note: Sparse routing is documented through the explicit architecture reference, but no active count for this audio variant is disclosed. Total and active counts cannot be inferred from one another.

architecture.note: The Live Translate architecture section explicitly directs readers to Gemini 3 Pro, whose card specifies a sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer. This establishes the architectural class, not identical parameter counts.

context_window.note: Exact endpoint input-token limit. The separate output-token limit is 65536; it is not added to the catalog value.

modalities.note: The endpoint accepts speech and emits translated audio plus optional transcripts. Text output is transcription, not general text-chat generation. Although the broader model card lists audio and text inputs, the exact endpoint page and translation guide explicitly restrict public input to audio.

reasoning.note: The exact endpoint explicitly does not support thinking. Generic family language about reasoning in the shared audio card does not override the endpoint capability.

tool_call.note: Function calling and tools are explicitly unsupported for this translation endpoint.

description.value: Speech translation preview for more than 70 languages, with translated audio and optional transcripts through the Gemini Live API.
description.note: Baseline translation and language-coverage claims are supported. Clarifies the preview delivery channel and the limited role of text output.

patch.description: Speech translation preview for more than 70 languages, with translated audio and optional transcripts through the Gemini Live API.

sources.label: Google DeepMind Gemini 3.5 Audio model card

patch.notes: Sparse MoE Transformer architecture follows the exact model card's explicit Gemini 3 Pro reference; total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed. Text output denotes transcripts accompanying speech translation, not general text-chat generation. The public endpoint accepts audio only despite the broader model card's audio-and-text input statement. Earliest public preview: June 9, 2026; Cloud's August date is later platform availability.

summary: Confirmed the exact preview identity, Google/Gemini Pro lineage, June 9 public release, closed weights, 131072-token input limit, audio-only input, translated audio/transcript output, and absence of thinking and tools. Added proprietary license classification and MoE architecture through an explicit first-party architecture reference. Clarified transcript output scope. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed after exact-model and later-card checks; no sibling size or capability was transferred. Documentation was inspected, but no authenticated endpoint operation was tested.
